meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或一段文案变成一支产品发布宣传片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上只有产品链接或一段文案,却要快速做出一支能直接投放的发布短片。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or a short brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if all you have is a product link or a brief but need a ready-to-post launch video.

howto.what: 它把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或简述做成发布/推广视频:先抓取页面素材,再定设计系统、写分镜与脚本、备音轨、逐帧构建,最后在 videos/<项目>/ 下渲染出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你要求营销、发布、推广或揭晓某个产品时接管;商业网址默认走这里,网站导览/展示类请求也归它。意图不明则先交给 /hyperframes。

howto.what_en: Turns a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: captures page assets, picks a design system, plans storyboard and script, builds frames, and renders renders/video.mp4 under videos/<project>/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours and showcases route here too. Unclear intent goes to /hyperframes.
